name: Nuno Workwear
description: Nuno Workwear is a documentary, sans-serif WordPress block theme designed for workwear and safety clothing shops, repair workshops, and trade outfitters. Built around a split-navigation layout, dashed column guides, and high-contrast ink-and-ground section rhythms, it operates smoothly as a standalone business catalogue or alongside WooCommerce. The design provides structured templates for trade-specific workwear specs, alteration price lists, and crew fitting services.

fonts.role: display: headings, navigation, buttons, numbers (variable 100-900, Latin subset)
text: body copy and labels (variable 200-800, Latin subset)

summary.en: A workwear shop and repair workshop: giant two-line headline across a half-height photograph, dashed column guides with a trade card mosaic, and ink bands.
